name: Release v3.10.0
body:
### 🚀 Features

- **(model-routing)** centralize routes in YAML and expose supported languages (#741) by SWHL in [75946b1](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/75946b1d2684db4dff77bbdbf2c0555a1d17eade)
- **(models)** add multilingual model routing and licensing metadata. (issue #739) by SWHL in [4a3070f](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/4a3070f304467e6d426e78a82afea5cb1181f305)
- support loading raw memory image buffers with format and stride metadata by SWHL in [deea2a0](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/deea2a03e670bfbcbe06536d4df75cd20ec7f6f9)
- support decoding images from memory addresses (issue #738) by SWHL in [64b1c68](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/64b1c680be9992b7500aecd89a484d161443612a)
- validate python-bidi before initializing Arabic OCR (issue #719) by SWHL in [0e629c8](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/0e629c8be05635035c01a829d10a91bbcd56a27a)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **(det)** honour limit_side_len when limit_type is max (issue #740) (#742) by Mohammad Hijjawi in [f65c7da](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/f65c7da00e72c19c258245e8e0e5f33af14488be)
- **(mnn)** use getNumpyData() instead of getData() for output extraction (#717) by Horatiu George Todoran in [667d04c](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/667d04c02998e7d5256a9369ecbf9da94a4e1c95)
- **(nrtr)** let generate_square_subsequent_mask take the device it is given (#731) by Tai An in [09f4e3b](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/09f4e3b185de0074de94d4e9c26a3ca2fb67fa8f)
- **(pytorch)** require PyTorch 1.13+ for secure model loading by SWHL in [e7edb01](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/e7edb012372f9ec5cf9e38a1e1e7b6abd489a2e7)
- **(rec)** honour model_root_dir for the rec dict and str paths in torch engine (#752) by Rett Wilson in [332b4fc](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/332b4fcc235bf7734df01527e35dde66f8d0d25b)
- correct model SHA256 by SWHL in [bd941da](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/bd941dae09da793e76c6ba15c7aaf40f8424232a)
- load torch weights with weights_only=True to prevent code execution (#728) by Patrick Chilton in [1087d4a](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/1087d4a6ec08ee49e6dfe9f3813a9e76f0ce1127)
- lock lazy model load so first use constructs once (#725) by Yuzhong Zhang in [486ec53](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/486ec538d3c5196ff95864f501bc56916dcf4ba5)
- update star-history chart by SWHL in [dd48f2d](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/dd48f2d7be03d7bb4f38b2783a45775f001ced76)

### 💼 Other

- **(python)** make OpenCV headless by default with optional GUI support (issue #737) by SWHL in [c1ec605](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/c1ec6054a7c36ebb25962a4884a5430212b7756f)

### 📚 Documentation

- add Backer by SWHL in [549847d](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/549847df506a32421086d2a08d19646ee958a6e0)
- add Backer by SWHL in [8eb4aae](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/8eb4aaef9f032a5b7c5b19443498156e4ab37f75)

### ⚡ Performance

- lazily initialize OCR models by SWHL in [0ad7c04](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/0ad7c04d8cc4003ad9add23691864807b2ca0a31)

### ⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

- remove optional OpenCV dependency by SWHL in [d6e304b](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/d6e304be35e60610d717e70120525e1cb384b9b1)
- update sponsor way by SWHL in [9936171](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/9936171fa42eb4ca4d900941c827c80f6847535b)
- ignore bundled OCR model files by SWHL in [cbea36a](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/cbea36ab3df61bc681216411c25c407ee7e0ed18)
- update pre-commit configuration by SWHL in [9ceb342](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/9ceb3420f551643d6daaf2ae9e06d09c37edca6a)
- update star-tracker range by SWHL in [3efd66a](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/3efd66a6ba32ff6b7ae1c7a36b8a3cb54c93e53c)

### 🎉 Contributors

- [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL)
- [@RettWilson22](https://github.com/RettWilson22)
- [@MohammadHijjawi97](https://github.com/MohammadHijjawi97)
- [@Anai-Guo](https://github.com/Anai-Guo)
- [@chpatrick](https://github.com/chpatrick)
- [@BetterAndBetterII](https://github.com/BetterAndBetterII)
- [@todorangrg](https://github.com/todorangrg)

**Full Changelog**:  [3.10.0](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/compare/v3.9.2..v3.10.0)

name: Release v3.9.2
body:
### 🚀 Features

- add use_preprocess_img and use_vertical_padding logic by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [3cc33f8](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/3cc33f8d54950d4e81106643bb99a920eb795125)
- add use_preprocess_img and use_apply_vertical_padding parameter by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [83866d6](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/83866d6a5cf0002db1abfb426796b88213035f78)
- verify RapidOCR model accuracy under TensorRT inference engine. Details in blog: [RapidOCR PP-OCRv6 Supports TensorRT Inference Engine](https://link.wtturl.cn/?target=https%3A%2F%2Frapidai.github.io%2FRapidOCRDocs%2Flatest%2Fblog%2F2026%2F07%2F05%2Fsupport-pp-ocrv6-tensorrt-engine%2F&scene=im&aid=497858&lang=zh)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- improve IDE support for lazy package exports by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [0962933](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/096293330eb0e96700e3775ab7b7166cdbb385fd)
- fixed issue #695 by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [0fa7a96](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/0fa7a9664c61de5a07d4fcb1a81e296f6764a691)
- fixed issue #709 by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [802c056](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/802c05647f705cb225b637533d303e137fa38922)
- align the performance of the torch version of the PP-OCRv6 Rec tiny model by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [b64a46f](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/b64a46ffd4fc370e4e2c5a10c485cb26e40b8b0f)

### 🧪 Testing

- remove invalid unit testings of tensorrt module by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [c4db82f](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/c4db82f7aca76404a56c514f62b2d2df735a3288)
- add PP-OCRv3 mobile unit testings by [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL) in [bce0c99](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR/commit/bce0c99be9914e7df9a7590a68a65056a8b78438)

### 🎉 Contributors

- [@SWHL](https://github.com/SWHL)
